Loss of control removes the whole subsidiary and NCI;only parent reserve10.4 recycles,including when20% is retained. Both disposals end with equity353.8 but different cash and investment. exit_state: Chapter10 ends at243. Elimination requires matched transactions and unreused allocations;inventory markup follows the remaining lot. IAS29 restates purchasing power before IAS21 translation,with monetary exposure,first-application tax and comparative histories kept distinct. Exchangeability depends on direction,date and purpose;an observed rate does not establish the required estimate. Chapter11 starts at244. JPMorgan's disclosures distinguish parent,bank,issuer and guarantor,then parent earnings,cash,transfer capacity and consolidated restricted cash. Dividend declarations,capital-rule elections and eligible retained income have different clocks. The payout-restrictions subsection continues beyond246.

findings.observation: The group chapter closes with source-matched eliminations,net monetary exposure and purpose-specific exchangeability. Each numeric example exposes a different misleading aggregate. The new methods explicitly require a successor to the closed group profile rather than claiming existing support.

The banking opening uses qualified actual filings without treating a subsidiary list as a complete control graph. Parent-only cash,consolidated restricted cash and a dated dividend-capacity disclosure retain their different scopes. The regulatory payout subsection is still in progress.
